description:
What this is. Once a month you record which illnesses were seen and how many people had each one. It does not need to be perfect — what makes it useful is doing it every month, so you can see whether something is getting better or worse over time.

A guided tour. Opening this step walks you through the page one box at a time and explains what each one is for. You can start it again whenever you like with the small i button at the top of the page.

Where to find it. To see the ones already there, open Health Monthly Report from the menu on the left.
name: Review the Health Monthly Report
title: Health Monthly Report — the monthly summary
